_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kuna wasa Klondike Solitaire. Burin ku shine ku motsa duk katin zuwa rumbun foundation.

Ka'idojin Wasa:
- Rumbun foundation (F1-F4): Gina daga Ace zuwa King a suit
- Rumbun tableau (T1-T7): Gina zuwa kasa kamar yadda launi ke canzawa (ja a kan baki, baki a kan ja)
- Stock: Zana katin zuwa rumbun waste
- Waste (W): Katin da ke saman rumbun waste anayezuwa ya wasa

Umarni:
- 'draw' - Zana katin daga stock zuwa waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Motsa katin tsakanin rumbun
  Misalai: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count kuma ya kan kasance 'all', wanda zai motsa duk katin da ke fuskantar zuwa.
- 'forfeit' - Kammala wasan nan take da kulle maki yanzu
- Sunayen rumbun: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Zaka iya aiwatar da ayyuka da dama a juyi daya kwa kuyiyar da su da comma:
  Misali: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings kadai za ka iya sa a kan rumbun tableau da ba katin.
Ayyuka suna aiwatar a tsari - idan daya ya kasa, ayyukan da suka rage za ka tsallake.
Ka yi amfani da 'forfeit' idan kuka yi imani wasan ya zama wanda ba za ka yi nasara ba.

format_error.no_brackets: Tsarin aiki mara inganci. Ya kamata a sanya aiki a cikin baka.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Tsarin aiki mara inganci. Rashin ƙwanƙwasawar rufewa ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Umurnin motsawa yana buƙatar tushe da manufa. Amfani: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Adadin ya kamata ya kasance mai kyau ko 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Adadin ba daidai ba. Amfani da nambari ko 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Umarni ba sananne ba '{cmd}'. Amfani da 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', ko 'forfeit'

move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: An tura katin daga sharar zuwa tushe F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Ba za a iya motsa katin sharar gida zuwa wannan tushe ba

move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Ba za a iya motsa katin zane zuwa wannan tushe ba

move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Za a iya motsa katin 1 kawai daga sharar gida zuwa zane
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: An tura katin daga sharar zuwa tebur T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Ba za a iya sanya katin da aka watsar a kan wannan tarin zane ba
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: An motsa {count} katin ((s) daga tebur T{src} zuwa T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Ba za a iya motsa {count} katin ((s) daga T{src} zuwa T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Za a iya motsa katin 1 kawai daga tushe zuwa tableau
